info.title: EdgeAI Server API
info.description: Read faces, people, vehicles and number plates detected by your Luckfox Pico cameras. Every detection carries absolute image URLs (full frame, face crop, plate crop, vehicle crop). When the server runs with -api-key, send a key (the master key, or one made with POST /keys) as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>`; image URLs and the WebSocket also accept `?api_key=`. Image links in responses carry an expiring signature in that case, so img tags work without the key.

post.description: New detections are POSTed to `url` as `{event:"detection.created", delivery_id, created_ms, data:<Detection>}` with header `X-EdgeAI-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using the secret>`. Reply 2xx within 5 s; failures are retried after 1 s, 5 s and 25 s, then dropped.

201.description: Created; the secret is returned only here

get.description: Upgrade to WebSocket. Messages are `{"kind":"event","data":<legacy event row>}` for each new detection and `{"kind":"device","data":<Device>}` for heartbeats. Optional `?type=face|vehicle` limits event messages. Browsers cannot set headers on WebSockets, so pass `?api_key=` when auth is on. Prefer webhooks for server-to-server use; the event row here uses relative image paths (`frame_url`, `crop_url`, `extra_url`) — fetch the absolute form with GET /detections/{id}.
